enforcement.tokenBoundary: Checked before run_code and nested calls; an in-flight provider response cannot be interrupted at an exact token, and this budget never aborts the outer Agent.
enforcement.tokenMetric: Runtime charges only newly generated assistant Usage.output tokens, including reasoning. recommended.maxTotalTokens is retained as the legacy benchmark config key; input and cached context do not consume the per-task budget.

common.note: Task call/token budgets and independent per-run compute/wall ceilings are enforced by model ID. Model thinking and ordinary tools do not consume run time. maxModules remains advisory because arbitrary code does not expose a reliable module count.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol.rationale: Passed every tested level; F7 completed with 128 writes, one test run, about 97k tokens.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-terra.rationale: Passed F7, but F7 rose to about 190k tokens; F6 is the practical unattended limit.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna.rationale: F1-F5 passed, while both F6 and F7 were 2/3. Bulk-write planning becomes stochastic above 48 modules.

dashscope/deepseek-v4-flash.rationale: Passed F7 historically, but token use climbed from about 51k at F5 to 119k at F6 and 283k at F7. A monitored F3 correction needed a seventh run_code and about 81k tokens; the revised call/token budget permits that correction, the per-run wall ceiling covers nested-tool waits, and the 60-write cap still prevents repeated full rewrites at the 48-module recommendation.

dashscope/deepseek-v4-pro.rationale: F6 completed near 70k tokens. F7 passed but rewrote all 128 modules twice and used about 185k tokens.
